# strictcode registry

Rule registry artifacts (mint-once IDs and retired-rule records)

## registry dump

Write the committed registry dump (rules with their per-language support cells, groups, and retired-rule records) as JSON

**Effect:** mutating

**Dry run:** not supported — the dump is written with a direct file write, outside the effects handle, so a preview would report nothing while the real run rewrites the file

### Flags

| Name | Short | Type | Presence | Env | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out` |  | str | optional |  | Output path for the registry dump; omitted means schema/registry.json |
